turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste any of it. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went up where he could read it on his phone in the middle of a class?
I'm waiting, Hale. That zero comes off, and I'd like to know on what basis it went on.
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Don't manage me, Hale. If his reading is years ahead of the class, then tell me why he has a zero.
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Then why are we sitting here? Compliments aren't evidence, and I still haven't heard what you based the zero on.
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
"My way" already put a zero in front of my son before anyone called me. You don't get my blessing, Hale, you get my questions. What do you actually have?
